headline: Regional Administrations Remove Official Portraits Of Gibran Raka
seoTitle: Regional Offices Remove Gibran Raka Portraits
metaDescription: Government offices across Indonesia are removing official portraits of Gibran Rakabuming Raka following his resignation as Vice President.
aiSummaryBullets: Regional government offices and public institutions across Indonesia have begun removing official portraits of former Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
The removals follow directives from regional leaders and administrative officials in provinces such as North Sumatra, Yogyakarta, and West Java.
Reports indicate that portrait removals have extended beyond government offices to include educational institutions and public facilities.
aiContextParagraph: Following the resignation of Gibran Rakabuming Raka from his position as the 14th Vice President of Indonesia, various regional administrations have initiated the removal of his official portraits from government offices and public buildings. Directives to remove these images have been issued by regional authorities, including the leadership in North Sumatra and the provincial government of Jakarta. In Yogyakarta, officials confirmed the removal of the portraits from the governor's office and mayoral workspace, citing standard administrative procedures. Similar actions have been observed in other regions, with some instances occurring in schools and public spaces. Local government officials have characterized these removals as compliance with current protocols following the change in status of the former officeholder. The trend of removing official portraits is being carried out across multiple administrative levels as regional offices adjust their displays to reflect the current status of the vice presidency.
whyItIsViral: The story is widely covered by six independent outlets with high reporting velocity, indicating significant regional interest in the administrative response to the resignation.
